shortDescription: Export the primary Security Management Server database or the primary Multi-Domain Server database or the single Domain database and the applicable Check Point configuration.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: domain_name
options.description:
Domain name to be exported.
Required only for exporting a Domain from the Multi-Domain Server or backing up Domain.

options.name: file_path
options.description:
Path in which the exported database file is saved.
Required only when not using pre-export-verification-only flag.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Ignoring the verification warnings. By Setting this parameter to 'true' export will not be blocked by warnings.

options.name: include_endpoint_configuration
options.description: Include export of the Endpoint Security Management configuration files.

options.name: include_endpoint_database
options.description: Include export of the Endpoint Security Management database.

options.name: is_domain_backup
options.description: If true, the exported Domain will be suitable for import on the same Multi-Domain Server only.

options.name: is_smc_to_mds
options.description: If true, the exported Security Management Server will be suitable for import on the Multi-Domain Server only.

options.name: pre_export_verification_only
options.description: If true, only runs the pre-export verifications instead of the full export.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
